items.description: Replacement of stolen clothing, personal effects and everyday jewellery
items.rationale: Sections 2.6.3 and 4.2.6 require the schedule to include movable property for forcible removal, which is not confirmed. If covered, §§4.4.5–4.4.6 and 7.1.1(d) support like-for-like new replacement without the high-value per-article cap; €650 is provisional because no itemised inventory is supplied.

items.description: Emergency repair and re-securing of forced back door
items.rationale: If forcible removal is insured for the building, §2.6.2 covers the forced-door damage even without contents cover. Allow €320 gross for one attendance, temporary boarding and basic like-for-like securing under §5.2.2, below its €1,000 event cap and without duplicate recovery under Part 7.
